summary: The diff implements all 10 requirements (REQ-41 through REQ-50) with good coverage. Most acceptance criteria are satisfied. One minor discrepancy: the WhatsApp pre-filled message text in FloatingBookWhatsAppButton.tsx says 'Omm Vedic Numerology' but the spec requires 'Omm Vedic Numerloggy'. The getTotalBookingCount backend query is public with no auth check, which aligns with the spec. The SpiritualProfileQuiz is placed between Services and Testimonials. The DailyCosmicInsight section is placed between Testimonials and WhyChooseUs as required. Overall implementation is comprehensive.

missing_requirements.requirement: The pre-filled WhatsApp message must exactly read: 'Hi, I would like to book a consultation with Omm Vedic Numerloggy. Please let me know the available slots.'
missing_requirements.reason: The FloatingBookWhatsAppButton.tsx uses 'Omm Vedic Numerology' (correctly spelled) instead of the spec-required brand name 'Omm Vedic Numerloggy' (intentional brand misspelling used throughout the project).
